# awscc_sagemaker_workteam (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::SageMaker::Workteam



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) A description of the work team.
- `member_definitions` (Attributes List) A list of MemberDefinition objects that contains objects that identify the workers that make up the work team. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--member_definitions))

### Optional

- `notification_configuration` (Attributes) Configures SNS notifications of available or expiring work items for work teams. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--notification_configuration))
- `tags` (Attributes List) An array of key-value pairs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `workforce_name` (String) The name of the Workforce
- `workteam_name` (String) The name of the work team.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `workteam_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) that identifies the work team.

<a id="nestedatt--member_definitions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `member_definitions`

Optional:

- `cognito_member_definition` (Attributes) The Amazon Cognito user group that is part of the work team (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--member_definitions--cognito_member_definition))
- `oidc_member_definition` (Attributes) A list user groups that exist in your OIDC Identity Provider (IdP). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--member_definitions--oidc_member_definition))

<a id="nestedatt--member_definitions--cognito_member_definition"></a>
### Nested Schema for `member_definitions.cognito_member_definition`

Optional:

- `cognito_client_id` (String) An identifier for an application client. You must create the app client ID using Amazon Cognito.
- `cognito_user_group` (String) An identifier for a user group.
- `cognito_user_pool` (String) An identifier for a user pool. The user pool must be in the same region as the service that you are calling.


<a id="nestedatt--member_definitions--oidc_member_definition"></a>
### Nested Schema for `member_definitions.oidc_member_definition`

Optional:

- `oidc_groups` (List of String) A list of OIDC group names whose members will be part of this workteam



<a id="nestedatt--notification_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `notification_configuration`

Optional:

- `notification_topic_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Amazon SNS topic to which notifications should be published.


<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String) The key of the tag.
- `value` (String) The value of the tag.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_sagemaker_workteam.example
  identity = {
    workteam_arn = "workteam_arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `workteam_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) that identifies the work team

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_sagemaker_workteam.example
  id = "workteam_arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_sagemaker_workteam.example "workteam_arn"
```
